en: [[The company]] [[is having]] [[difficulties]] because of the highly competitive situation in the market, especially since one of its biggest competitors has recently launched a similar product.
me: because of the highly competitive situation in the market,
especially since one of its biggest competitors has recently launched a similar product.
easy: because of the highly competitive situation in the market
since one of its biggest competitors has recently launched a similar product
가장 큰 경쟁사 중 하나가 최근 비슷한 제품을 출시했기 때문에.
요약: 강력한 경쟁사의 신제품 때문에 회사가 힘들다.
notes: one of + 복수명사가 주어면 진짜 주어는 one → 단수동사: one of its competitors has(have ✕)
recently(최근에)는 현재완료(has launched = 출시했다, launch(출시하다))와 잘 어울린다

en: [[Pamela]] [[asked]] [[her dad]] [[whether she should choose to major in medicine or art]], though she still wasn't sure what mattered most to her future.
me: whether she should choose to major in medicine or art,
though she still wasn't sure what mattered most to her future.
easy: whether she should choose to major in medicine or art
의학과 미술 중 무엇을 전공하기로 선택해야 할지.
though she still wasn't sure what mattered most to her future
비록 무엇이 자신의 미래에 가장 중요한지는 여전히 확신하지 못했지만.
요약: 전공을 아버지께 물었지만 진짜 중요한 게 뭔지는 아직 모른다.
notes: what + 동사(주어가 빠진 불완전한 절) = 무엇이 ~인지. what mattered = 무엇이 중요한지 (matter(중요하다)). that ✕
ask + 사람 + whether절 = ~인지 ~에게 묻다

en: The patient, as the doctor emphasized, [[must have]] [[meals]] and take medicine at fixed times, though he sometimes forgets to take his medicine on time.
key: 환자는 식사를 하고 약을 먹어야 한다.
me: and take medicine at fixed times,
though he sometimes forgets to take his medicine on time.
easy: The patient must have meals and take medicine
그 환자는 식사를 하고 약을 먹어야 한다.
though he sometimes forgets to take his medicine on time
비록 그가 때때로 제시간에 약 먹는 것을 잊어버리지만.
요약: 약은 정해진 시간에 먹어야 하는데 환자가 가끔 깜빡한다.
notes: forget to + 동사원형 = (앞으로 할 일을) 깜빡하다, forget + -ing = (이미 한 일을) 잊다. 약 먹는 걸 깜빡 → forgets to take(먹다)
조동사 must 뒤에는 동사원형: must have(가지다), take (take medicine = 약을 먹다)

en: Some days, [[you]] [[might not understand]] [[why the people around you act so strangely]], especially while you are under a lot of stress yourself.
me: why the people around you act so strangely,
especially while you are under a lot of stress yourself.
easy: why the people around you act so strangely
주변 사람들이 왜 그렇게 이상하게 행동하는지.
especially while you are under a lot of stress yourself
특히 당신 자신이 많은 스트레스를 받고 있는 동안에는.
요약: 내가 스트레스를 받을 땐 남들의 이상한 행동이 이해가 안 될 수 있다.
notes: while + 주어+동사(절) = ~하는 동안, during + 명사(구). you are under …는 절이니까 while
be under stress = 스트레스를 받고 있다. act(행동하다)를 꾸미는 말은 부사 strangely(이상하게)

en: [[It]] [[is]] perhaps [[surprising]] how music can trigger strong emotions and memories, a topic one team of researchers had explored long before modern brain-scanning tools existed.
me: how music can trigger strong emotions and memories,
a topic one team of researchers had explored long before modern brain-scanning tools existed.
easy: how music can trigger strong emotions and memories
음악이 강한 감정과 기억을 불러일으킬 수 있다는 것이.
a topic one team of researchers had explored
long before modern brain-scanning tools existed
현대의 뇌 스캔 도구가 존재하기 훨씬 전에.
요약: 음악이 감정을 일으키는 이유는 뇌 스캔이 나오기 전에 이미 연구되었다.
notes: 과거완료(had + p.p.) = 과거의 어느 때보다 더 앞서 일어난 일. 탐구한 일이 도구가 존재한(existed) 때보다 앞 → had explored(탐구했었다, explore(탐구하다))
It is ~ how …: It은 가짜 주어, how 이하가 진짜 내용

en: [[Molly]] [[received]] [[a phone call]] from a mysterious person during her lunch break at work, leaving her feeling confused about who it might have been.
me: from a mysterious person during her lunch break at work,
leaving her feeling confused about who it might have been.
easy: from a mysterious person during her lunch break at work
leaving her feeling confused about who it might have been
그것이 누구였을지 몰라 그녀가 혼란스러움을 느끼게 하면서.
요약: 정체불명의 전화를 받고 Molly는 혼란스러웠다.
notes: 감정을 느끼는 사람 → 과거분사(-ed): Molly가 혼란을 느끼니까 confused(혼란스러운), confusing ✕
might have + p.p. = ~였을지도 모른다 (지난 일의 추측): who it might have been = 그게 누구였을지

en: Looking at the view from the top of the mountain, [[we]] [[couldn't believe]] [[where we stood]], a view that stayed in our memory as we had visited it a hundred times before.
me: Looking at the view from the top of the mountain,
a view that stayed in our memory as we had visited it a hundred times before.
easy: we couldn't believe where we stood
우리는 우리가 서 있는 곳을 믿을 수 없었다.
Looking at the view from the top of the mountain
a view that stayed in our memory
as we had visited it a hundred times before
전에 백 번은 와 본 것처럼.
요약: 산꼭대기의 풍경은 와 본 적 있는 듯 기억에 남았다.
notes: like + 명사(구)(전치사), as + 주어+동사(절)(접속사). we had visited it처럼 절이 오면 as
where we stood = 우리가 서 있던 곳 (stood = stand(서다)의 과거)

en: [[My parents and I]] [[don't agree]] whether I should go to college in another city, since each of us has too many opinions about what is best for my future.
me: whether I should go to college in another city,
since each of us has too many opinions about what is best for my future.
easy: My parents and I don't agree
whether I should go to college in another city
내가 다른 도시로 대학을 가야 할지에 대해.
since each of us has too many opinions
우리 각자가 너무 많은 의견을 가지고 있기 때문에.
about what is best for my future
요약: 각자 생각이 달라서 대학 문제로 의견이 엇갈린다.
notes: many + 셀 수 있는 복수명사 (many opinions), much + 셀 수 없는 명사 (much water). opinions는 셀 수 있으니 much ✕
each of us의 진짜 주어는 each → 단수동사 has

en: At dinner, [[Justin]] [[said]] [[that he would join the army]], and what he said surprised his family, although everyone tried to talk him out of it for hours.
me: that he would join the army,
and what he said surprised his family,
although everyone tried to talk him out of it for hours.
easy: Justin said that he would join the army
and what he said surprised his family
그리고 그가 한 말은 가족을 놀라게 했다.
although everyone tried to talk him out of it for hours
비록 모두가 몇 시간 동안 그를 설득해 말리려 했지만.
요약: 입대하겠다는 말에 가족이 놀랐고, 오래 말려도 소용없었다.
notes: although + 주어+동사(절), despite + 명사(구). everyone tried …는 절이니까 although
what he said = 그가 한 말 (what = ~하는 것) → 이 덩어리가 주어

en: [[Bees]] [[do well]] in the suburbs since flowers in people's gardens provide a constant supply of honey, a balance that has been disrupted whenever pesticides are used nearby.
me: since flowers in people's gardens provide a constant supply of honey,
a balance that has been disrupted whenever pesticides are used nearby.
easy: since flowers in people's gardens provide a constant supply of honey
정원의 꽃들이 꾸준한 꿀 공급을 제공하기 때문에.
a balance that has been disrupted whenever pesticides are used nearby
살충제가 근처에서 쓰일 때마다 무너지는 균형.
요약: 교외의 꽃 덕에 벌이 잘 살지만, 살충제가 그 균형을 깬다.
notes: 주어가 동작을 '당하면' 수동태(be + p.p.): 균형(a balance)은 무너뜨리는 쪽이 아니라 무너지는 쪽 → has been disrupted(무너졌다, disrupt(무너뜨리다))
whenever = ~할 때마다 (뒤에 주어+동사가 이어진다)

en: Although the weather was windy and rainy, [[the athletes]] [[continued]] [[training for the upcoming game]], pushing themselves harder than they ever had before.
me: Although the weather was windy and rainy,
pushing themselves harder than they ever had before.
easy: Although the weather was windy and rainy
pushing themselves harder than they ever had before
그 어느 때보다 더 열심히 스스로를 몰아붙이면서.
요약: 궂은 날씨에도 선수들은 전보다 더 열심히 훈련했다.
notes: 비교급 만들기: 1음절 부사·형용사는 -er (hard → harder(더 열심히)). hard에 more를 붙이면 ✕
비교하는 대상은 than 뒤에: harder than they ever had before = 전에 했던 것보다 더 열심히

en: [[Environmental groups]] [[argue]] [[whether European customers are making water shortages worse in Africa]], a claim critics have called increasingly controversial in recent years.
me: whether European customers are making water shortages worse in Africa,
a claim critics have called increasingly controversial in recent years.
easy: whether European customers are making water shortages worse in Africa
유럽 소비자들이 아프리카의 물 부족을 더 악화시키고 있는지.
a claim critics have called increasingly controversial in recent years
비평가들이 최근 몇 년간 점점 더 논란이 많다고 불러 온 주장.
요약: 유럽 소비자가 아프리카 물 부족을 키우는지를 두고 논란이 커지고 있다.
notes: 형용사를 꾸미는 말은 부사: increasingly(점점 더, 부사) + controversial(논란이 많은, 형용사). increasing(증가하는)은 형용사라서 ✕
call A B = A를 B라고 부르다 (have called a claim controversial = 주장을 논란이 많다고 불러 왔다)
